The '''Kardurans''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to [[Kardura system/Legends|Kardura system]]. They were slim [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] known for their dancing troupes. They were a client species of [[House Kassido]].
